plan.what: Validate the supplied image path and load the image bytes into global state.
plan.fails_if: IMAGE_PATH env var missing or file does not exist.

plan.what: Create a PDF where the first page shows a centered title and the full‑size image, then render markdown content starting on page two, forcing at least three pages.
Encode the generated PDF bytes as base64 and output the required JSON key.
plan.fails_if: Base64 encoding fails or no PDF bytes are present.

notes: Maturation rubric: The image must occupy the full first page with a title above it. Markdown content (# heading, ## subheading, paragraphs, bullets) must start on page 2. Content must overflow to at least 3 pages total. Body text uses Helvetica; headings use Helvetica-Bold at 2x body size.
